Public protested by intercepting a government bus near Tiruvallur over drinking water shortages, and the office should direct local bodies to restore supply.

Tiruvallur district administration tightened paddy movement surveillance after trader malpractices at DPCs, and the office should ensure fair procurement.
The University Grants Commission approved India's first foreign university campus in Chennai for the University of Western Australia, and the office should facilitate state support.
Meta will lease a 168 MW AI-enabled data center in Jamnagar from Reliance, and the office should track infrastructure trends for Tamil Nadu's digital policy.
Studies revealed TVK won seats with high voter deletions during the SIR electoral roll revision, and the office should monitor political developments.
BJP leader Vanathi Srinivasan condemned the Tamil Nadu government over law and order following a murder in Tiruttani, and the office should note the political criticism.
Prime Minister Narendra Modi will visit Chennai on October 11 to launch the Chennai Metro phase two operational line, and the office should prepare for the event.
Prime Minister Modi will inaugurate the Ilaiyaraaja Music Research Centre at IIT Madras during his visit, and the office should coordinate logistical support.
